title: Classes
description: A class connects curriculum to learners. Assign the courses a class studies, then enroll the students who take them.
forbidden_title: Classes are not available to you
forbidden_body: Managing classes needs an active Team Lead or Manager membership. Ask an academy manager to change your role.
unavailable_body: The server did not answer. Refresh the page, and tell your administrator if it keeps failing.
empty: No classes yet. Create one for the group you teach next.
empty_filtered: No class matches this filter. Clear the filter to see the rest.

create.heading: Name the class
create.body: Give the class a name your staff will recognize. You assign courses and enroll students on the next screen.
create.next_step: You go straight to the class, where you assign courses and enroll students.
create.failed: Could not create the class. Check the name and try again.

edit_modal.heading: Edit class details
edit_modal.body: Change the name and description. Assigned courses and enrolled students stay as they are.
edit_modal.failed: Could not save the class. Reload it and try again.

detail.not_found_body: It may have been removed, or it belongs to another academy. Go back to the class list.
detail.archived_notice: This class is archived. Its students cannot open its courses until you restore it.

overview.courses_some_hidden_one: 1 hidden, so students cannot open it
overview.courses_some_hidden_other: {{count}} hidden, so students cannot open them
overview.last_change_note: Any edit, course, or roster change

courses_panel.heading: Courses
courses_panel.body: Students in this class can open every visible course assigned here.
courses_panel.empty: No courses assigned yet. Assign the first one to give this class something to learn.
courses_panel.hidden_note: Assigned, but hidden. Students cannot open it until the course is visible.

students_panel.heading: Students
students_panel.body: Enrolled students see this class's visible courses in their own course list.
students_panel.empty: No students enrolled yet. Add the students who take these courses.
students_panel.manager_only: Only a Manager can change who is enrolled.
students_panel.inactive_suspended: This membership is suspended, so the seat grants no access.
students_panel.inactive_role: This member is no longer a student, so the seat grants no access.

assign_dialog.heading: Assign courses
assign_dialog.body: Pick every course this class studies. Clearing a course removes access to it.
assign_dialog.no_courses: This academy has no courses yet. Create a course first.
assign_dialog.hidden_hint: Hidden courses can be assigned now and open for students once you make them visible.
assign_dialog.failed: Could not save the assignments. Reload the class and try again.

enroll_dialog.heading: Add students
enroll_dialog.body: Only active students of this academy appear here. Students already in this class are hidden.
enroll_dialog.none_eligible: Every active student is already enrolled in this class.
enroll_dialog.failed: Could not add the students. Reload the class and try again.

remove_course.heading: Remove this course?
remove_course.body: Students in “{{className}}” lose access to “{{courseTitle}}” right away. Their drafts, submissions, and progress stay saved, and reassigning the course brings all of it back.

remove_student.heading: Remove this student?
remove_student.body: {{name}} loses access to this class's courses right away. Their drafts, submissions, and progress stay saved, and re-enrolling brings all of it back.

archive_dialog.heading: Archive this class?
archive_dialog.body: Archiving stops this class from granting access. It keeps its courses and students, and restoring it puts everything back.
archive_dialog.preserved: Drafts, submissions, and progress stay saved. Restoring the class brings every access path back.
archive_dialog.failed: Could not archive the class. Try again in a moment.

load_failed: Could not load the latest classes. This is the last version that loaded.
